fields.climate: mostly arid or semiarid, subtropical along Caspian coast
fields.terrain: rugged, mountainous rim; high, central basin with deserts, mountains; small, discontinuous plains along both coasts
fields.hazards: periodic droughts, floods; dust storms, sandstorms; earthquakes
fields.resources: petroleum, natural gas, coal, chromium, copper, iron ore, lead, manganese, zinc, sulfur
fields.farm: wheat, sugarcane, milk, sugar beets, rice, tomatoes, barley, potatoes, oranges, apples
fields.exports: plastics, iron ore, alcohols, natural gas, refined copper
fields.industries: petroleum, petrochemicals, gas, fertilizer, caustic soda, textiles, cement and other construction materials, food processing (particularly sugar refining and vegetable oil production), ferrous and…
fields.languages: Persian Farsi (official), Azeri and other Turkic dialects, Kurdish, Gilaki and Mazandarani, Luri, Balochi, Arabic
fields.religions: Muslim (official) 98.5%, Christian 0.7%, Baha'i 0.3%, agnostic 0.3%, other (includes Zoroastrian, Jewish, Hindu) 0.2%
fields.legal: religious system based on secular and Islamic law
fields.military: 16 for voluntary military service for men; military service is compulsory for all Iranian men at age 18 or 19 years of age…
